name: Survival: hurt, bandages only in the backpack, a lone walker coming

steps._note: Prepared backpack-only healing case. Actual bandage movement/use and survival remain required assertions. Do not disable guard or clear genuine items to force a pass. Earlier setup-order failure is retained in the native batch report.

preconditions: Disposable flat open area, windows closed, guard ON. Verify no healing items in toolbelt before starting; existing healing stacks must be moved to a free backpack slot through actual inventory input during fixture preparation. Script provisions weapon and backpack bandages and selects the weapon BEFORE damage so setup does not race automatic healing.
